description: Per-page verdict for a PDF: text, scan (a picture with no text), empty, encrypted or broken, plus the exact command to fix it (ocrmypdf --skip-text for a mixed file, --redo-ocr for a full scan, qpdf --decrypt for a password). Use it when a PDF conversion returned no text. Free — this check does not use the quota.
name: check_pdf
title: Check whether a PDF has a text layer
